title: Southern Romania Steam Train
summary:
The is a steam train that the Huntik team used to go to a train station on the way to the Castle of Vlad Dracul. On the way, the train was attacked by Klaus' Suits. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

The train was later used again by Lok Lambert, Den Fears and Sophie Casterwill to return to the Vlad's Castle and contain the wild Titan Antedeluvian. [Lok's Leadership]
